target.statement: Whole-client deletion at k=10, T=0: total fresh/replay request-time ratio of 35.79x (compact replay) on the Adult dataset (one preselected client, five seeds).

compute.basis: Adult is a small tabular dataset (~48k rows, 14 features); the repo ships processed arrays and commands, and the T=0 compact path is a lightweight k-means++/summary replay over five seeds, so install + run + re-timing fits well under an hour on CPU.

blockers: Timing ratios are hardware- and load-dependent, so the exact 35.79x number will not reproduce numerically on a different laptop (only the qualitative >1 speedup is robust)
Requires the versioned v1.0.0 release artifacts (processed arrays, reconstruction recipes) to be intact
title: Machine Unlearning for Federated Socially Fair k-Means Clustering
